name: Gen AI Engineering
subtitle: Build useful generative AI applications.
description: Learn language model foundations, retrieval, evaluation, and production delivery. Build applications whose outputs you can inspect and improve.
outcomes: Build retrieval and language model workflows
Evaluate outputs and handle uncertain results

name: AI / ML Engineering
subtitle: Turn data into dependable models.
description: Connect Python, machine learning, deep learning, and MLOps. Practise building models, measuring errors, and operating the full model lifecycle.
outcomes: Prepare data and train baseline models

name: Cloud Platform Engineering
subtitle: Make reliable delivery a skill.
description: Follow infrastructure from containers to orchestration, cloud, automation, and operating production systems.
outcomes: Reason about reliability and production incidents

name: Full-stack Foundations
subtitle: Connect the application from interface to data.
description: Connect typed application code, APIs, persistence, and deployment. Use the Java full-stack guides and Node.js topics to build and explain a working application.
outcomes: Build and test typed application code

name: Backend Engineering
subtitle: Build services that hold up.
description: Connect language fundamentals, APIs, data, and distributed systems. Practise explaining your decisions and handling failure.

name: Forward Deployed Engineering
subtitle: Turn customer problems into deployed solutions.
description: Work from discovery and integration to deployment, evaluation, and handoff. Combine software, cloud, and AI foundations with customer-facing engineering.
outcomes: Define customer workflows and success measures
Deploy, operate, and hand off customer projects
